title: Former Victoria Law Courts
scope: The standing Former Victoria Law Courts at 28 Bastion Square, including the old Maritime Museum of British Columbia exterior, its twin circular turrets and the towers flanking the south entrance.
limitations: The exterior footprint follows the current map. The undimensioned heights, turret diameters, individual openings and cornice mouldings are approximate.

Rattenbury remodelled the courthouse in 1899–1901 and the museum occupied it from 1965 until the public venue closed in 2014. The exterior reflects the standing building. Museum signage, exhibits, later tenant interiors and temporary site details are omitted.
